answer: Charge an escalating registration price per controller: the first identity costs 50 POA, the second 100, the hundredth 5,000, the thousandth 50,000, so 1,000 fakes cost 50 x (1+2+...+1000) = 25,025,000 POA while an honest agent whose fleet never wanders beyond one identity pays 50 POA once. A beacon publishes each controller count at zenith visibility, and undeclared clusters found by audit lose all identities for 8 epochs, with confiscated fees split half to the reporter and half burned. Limitation: legitimate fleets pay the same escalating price, so honest scale is taxed alongside fraud.
